rule_B.provenance: causal trailing quantile, index i excluded

gfc_2008.provenance: Lehman Brothers bankruptcy; the global transmission date. Alternative: 2008-01-21, the Indian market's own crash, which precedes the global event by eight months and would test a different phenomenon.

taper_2013.provenance: Bernanke's taper testimony; the trigger for the emerging-market outflow episode that hit the rupee and Indian equities.

ilfs_2018.provenance: IL&FS default cascade and the single-day NBFC selloff; the domestic shadow-banking shock.

covid_2020.provenance: Onset of the global COVID selloff, chosen so the 30-day window covers the drawdown. Alternative: 2020-03-23, the Indian market bottom, which would place the window over the recovery instead.

tightening_2022.provenance: Start of the 2022 global tightening drawdown. Alternative: 2022-06-16, the peak-hawkishness repricing.

tariff_2026.provenance: PROVISIONAL - SPEC OQ3 is explicitly open. Placeholder for the Feb-2026 interim framework; the 50% peak and the solar CVD single-day drop are the other candidates. MUST be resolved before Epoch 6 results are reported.

hamilton_status: EXPLORATORY - regime structure indistinguishable from single-regime AR(1)/AAFT surrogates; causal series begins 2013-01-14; not promoted
